back_translation: If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and becomes another man's wife, can he return to her again? Would not that land be wholly defiled? But you have played the harlot with many lovers — and would you return to Me? declares the LORD.

Lift up your eyes to the bare heights and look: where have you not been violated? You sat waiting for your lovers beside the roads, like a nomad in the wilderness. You have defiled the land with your harlotry and your wickedness.
Therefore the rains were withheld, and the late spring rain did not come. Yet you had the brazen forehead of a prostitute; you refused to be ashamed.
Have you not just now called to Me, 'My Father, You are the friend of my youth'?
'Will He be angry forever? Will He keep His indignation to the end?' Behold, you have spoken this, yet you keep doing all the evil you can.
In the days of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, 'Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every green tree and played the harlot there.'
I thought that after she had done all these things she would return to Me, but she did not return; and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

I saw that for all the reasons that faithless Israel had committed adultery, I sent her away and gave her a certificate of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear, but went and played the harlot as well.
Because she treated her harlotry as a trivial thing, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and tree.
Yet in spite of all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not return to Me with her whole heart, but only in pretense, declares the LORD.
And the LORD said to me, 'Faithless Israel has shown herself more in the right than treacherous Judah.'

Go and proclaim these words toward the north: 'Return, O faithless Israel, declares the LORD. I will not look on you angrily anymore, for I am full of mercy, declares the LORD. I will not hold My anger forever.'
Only acknowledge your guilt, that you rebelled against the LORD your God and scattered your love to foreign gods under every green tree, and did not obey My voice, declares the LORD.
Return, O faithless children, declares the LORD, for I am your husband; and I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and bring you to Zion.
And I will give you shepherds after My own pleasing, who will shepherd you with knowledge and understanding.

And in those days, when you multiply and increase in the land, declares the LORD, people will no longer say 'the ark of the covenant of the LORD'; it will not come to mind, no one will remember it or miss it, and it will not be made again.
At that time they will call Jerusalem 'the Throne of the LORD,' and all the nations will gather to Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
In those days the house of Judah will walk together with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave as an inheritance to your fathers.

As for Me, I said, 'How gladly I would set you among the sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance among the nations!' And I thought you would call Me 'Father' and not turn away from Me.
But just as a woman betrays her husband, so you have betrayed Me, O house of Israel, declares the LORD.
A sound is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and pleading for mercy of the children of Israel, because they have made their way crooked and have forgotten the LORD their God.
Return, O faithless children, and I will heal your faithlessness. 'Behold, we have come to You, for You are the LORD our God.'
Surely the worship on the hills and the commotion on the mountains is a deception. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
From our youth that shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers — their flocks and herds, their sons and their daughters.

Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us, for we have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our fathers, from our youth until this very day, and we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
